narrative.overview:
He is named in his own language first. The banner writes இன்பத்தமிழன் ச by hand, one letter cluster at a time, then lets it settle as a quiet ground behind the Latin name at a whisper of the text colour; the Latin name, identity line and handle sit over it. The work follows as a calm two-column index: eight linked cards, each a hairline rule, a title and one plain sentence. Nothing is boxed, filled or shadowed; GitHub's own page shows through every image. Everything is set at a quiet scale: the banner is short and the cards are small.

The system lives entirely inside committed SVG and PNG files, because GitHub's sanitizer strips every stylesheet and script from the README. Each image carries its own subset fonts, its own dark and light twin, its own phone layer and its own motion. One neutral sage marks what is live: the handle, the project he is building now, and his busiest days. Secondary tones are never new hues; they are the theme's text colour at a lower opacity.

Motion arrives once and settles: the Tamil name traces itself left to right and fades into its faint fill, the grid and the small web fade in together, the handle, name and identity rise, then each card's rule draws across in reading order with its text rising after it. Afterwards only Aran's sage dot keeps pulsing.
keyCharacteristics: Tamil name first, with the initial (இன்பத்தமிழன் ச), as a ghost across about 78% of the banner (fg at 7% dark, 6% light) behind the Latin name.
Transparent images on GitHub's unpainted grounds, in matched dark and light twins.
Hind Madurai throughout; JetBrains Mono only for the handle.
One neutral sage, reserved for what is live or current; no warm accent.
Hairline rules instead of boxes; flat, no shadows.
Once-only entrance motion with a single loop, and reduced-motion fallbacks in every SVG.

rules.name: The Unpainted Ground Rule
rules.body: No image paints a background. Every SVG and PNG is transparent so it sits on whatever ground GitHub serves (dark, dimmed, light, high-contrast) without a seam.

rules.name: The One Sage Rule
rules.body: Sage marks only what is live: the handle square, the current project's "now" and dot, and the busiest grid days. A second accent, a warm accent, or sage used for decoration breaks the system.

rules.name: The Opacity, Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Quieter tones are the theme ink at an opacity, never a new grey or a new colour. That is what lets one file read on every GitHub ground.

rules.name: The Tamil First Rule
rules.body: The Tamil name comes before the Latin one, in reading order and in motion: it is written first, and it is the ground the Latin name sits on. It carries his initial (ச) wherever the Tamil name appears: ghost, identity line, alt and aria text.

rules.name: The Embedded Type Rule
rules.body: Every SVG embeds its own subset woff2 fonts as base64. GitHub serves images through ``, which loads no external fonts. A glyph missing from the subset is drawn, not substituted: DHṚTI's underdot is a circle (r 2.3 at 42, r 2.8 at 50) because Hind Madurai has no U+1E5A.

rules.name: The Half-Width Pair Rule
rules.body: Cards are exactly 50% wide, paired with no whitespace between them, and carry their own gutter inside the art. Never rely on Markdown spacing for layout.

rules.name: The Rendered-Width Rule
rules.body: Phone legibility is solved inside each SVG with a width media query keyed to that image's own rendered size; there is no page CSS to do it.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow or sits in a panel. Separation comes from hairline rules, opacity and space.

rules.name: The One Loop Rule
rules.body: Entrance motion plays once and settles; Aran's pulse is the only loop. Every animated SVG ends with a `prefers-reduced-motion` block that removes the animation and leaves the final state visible.

rules.name: The Grid Contract Rule
rules.body: The `<!--grid-->` markers, the grid origin (1034, 30), pitch 14, cell 10, radius 2 and the five-level palette live in both banner SVGs and in `scripts/update_grid.py`. Change one, change both.

rules.name: The One Link Per Image Rule
rules.body: An image can carry one link and no hotspots; every project is its own image, linked to its repo.

dos: **Do** ship every visual as a transparent SVG or PNG pair (dark and light) inside `` with `prefers-color-scheme`, with real alt text on the ``.
**Do** embed subset Hind Madurai (and JetBrains Mono for the handle) as base64 woff2 inside each SVG, and draw any glyph the subset lacks.
**Do** derive quiet tones from the theme ink at an opacity: ghost .07/.06, trace stroke .55, grid .06/.14/.26/.42, web .25, rules .22/.32.
**Do** keep sage for what is live: handle square, the current project's "now" and pulse, and the busiest grid days.
**Do** solve phone legibility inside each SVG with a media query on its own rendered width (banner 520, cards 300).
**Do** keep animated elements few and grouped (the grid and web fade as one group; the ghost's clusters share one trace), with a reduced-motion fallback in every file.
**Do** keep the grid markers and geometry in step with `scripts/update_grid.py`.
donts: **Don't** paint a background, box, panel or shadow behind any content; GitHub's ground always shows through.
**Don't** add a second accent colour, bring back amber or any warm yellow, or add a new grey; use the ink at an opacity.
**Don't** add a second loop; Aran's pulse is the only one.
**Don't** add tags, eyebrows or labels above titles; the lowercase "now" on the baseline is the only status.
**Don't** add icons outside the Toolbox strip, or turn the corner web into a character.
**Don't** rely on page CSS, scripts, hover states, image maps or external fonts; none survive GitHub's sanitizer or ``.
**Don't** put whitespace between paired card links; it breaks the two-column row.
